title: Mistakes and Forgetfulness
arabic_text: عَنِ [ابنِ عبَّاسٍ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُما، أَنَّ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قالَ: "إنَّ اللهَ تَجَاوَزَ لِي عَنْ أُمَّتِي: الْخَطَأَ، وَالنِّسْيَانَ، وَمَا اسْتُكْرِهُوا عَلَيْهِ".
english_translation: From Ibn ʿAbbās (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhumā) that the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) said, 'Allāh has overlooked my people for me, for [their] mistakes, [their] forgetfulness and for what they have done under compulsion.'
description: This Hadith states that Allah has forgiven the Muslim Ummah for actions committed due to mistakes, forgetfulness, or under compulsion. It provides comfort and hope to Muslims regarding unintentional errors.
